theorems.label: is-treewidth
theorems.statement: Under FPT ≠ W[1], no deterministic algorithm decides Independent Set within the stated running time. 2^(o_eff(t)) B^(O(1)). The maximum degree of G is at most three. The pathwidth of G equals its treewidth. The exponent h(t) is finite and nonnegative. There is a computable function T such that h(t) ≤ η max(t, 1) whenever t ≥ T(η), for each positive rational η. The proof also permits the solver to receive the exact width and an optimal path decomposition, counted in the complete input length.

title: An effective treewidth lower bound for Independent Set
